## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Motion graphics
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - MotionGraphics — sampling a tween
//  - IProcedural motion evaluation

library MotionGraphics
{
    //==
    // # MotionGraphics — sampling a tween
    //
    // The `ITimeVarying<T>` obligation of `Tween<T>`
    // (`motion-graphics.types.plato`): the eased blend from From to To across
    // Duration, after Delay. `Tween<T>` declares `where T: IInterpolatable`, which
    // is what licenses the Lerp on a bare T here.
    //
    // The other composition types in that file are data read by a renderer and
    // carry no obligation, so nothing else is derived here.

    // The tween's value at a time offset from the composition's start. Sampling
    // before Delay yields From, after Delay + Duration yields To; in between the
    // linear fraction is reshaped by Easing. A non-positive Duration is an
    // instantaneous switch at the delay.
    Sample(self: Tween<$T>, time: Duration): $T {
        var elapsed = time.Seconds - self.Delay.Seconds;
        var span = self.Duration.Seconds;
        var fraction = span <= 0.0
            ? (elapsed < 0.0 ? 0.0 : 1.0)
            : (elapsed / span).Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        return self.From.Lerp(self.To, self.Easing.Eval(fraction));
    }

    //==
    // # IProcedural motion evaluation
    //
    // The `ITimeVarying<Number>` obligation of `Oscillator`
    // (`motion-graphics.types.plato`): the signal
    // `Bias + Amplitude * wave(Frequency * time + Phase)` the type's doc comment
    // states, one waveform per case.
    //
    // Every waveform is normalized to [-1, 1] and phase-aligned with the sine, so
    // switching waveform changes the shape and nothing else — the signal still
    // leaves zero rising at phase zero and peaks a quarter turn later. That
    // alignment is why the triangle is written around a quarter-turn shift rather
    // than as the more obvious `2|2t - 1| - 1`.

    // The unit-amplitude waveform value at a phase angle, in [-1, 1].
    WaveformValue(waveform: OscillatorWaveform, phase: Angle): Number {
        var turns = phase.Turns;
        var cycle = turns - turns.Floor;
        var shifted = turns + 0.25 - (turns + 0.25).Floor;
        return match (waveform) {
            Sine => phase.Sin;
            // The sign of the sine: a hard edge at every zero crossing.
            Square => phase.Sin >= 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
            Triangle => 1.0 - 4.0 * (shifted - 0.5).Abs;
            // A rising ramp: -1 at the start of the cycle, +1 at its end.
            Sawtooth => 2.0 * cycle - 1.0;
            // Smooth pseudo-random: one dimension of lattice value noise walked
            // along the phase, so successive cycles differ but the signal stays
            // continuous.
            Noise => ValueNoise2D(0, 1.0).Eval(Point2D(turns, 0.0));
        };
    }

    // The phase of the oscillator at a time: the frequency carried over the
    // elapsed seconds, offset by the oscillator's own phase.
    PhaseAt(self: Oscillator, time: Duration): Angle
        => Angle(self.Frequency.Hertz * time.Seconds * Number.Tau + self.Phase.Radians);

    // The signal value at a time.
    Sample(self: Oscillator, time: Duration): Number
        => self.Bias + self.Amplitude * WaveformValue(self.Waveform, self.PhaseAt(time));
}
```
